raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-17 payments-source change delivers amount corrections as a new row with the same txn_id and record_version incremented, so silver_transactions keeps both versions and duplicates the key. The fix is to keep only the highest record_version per txn_id (across all statuses, so a later reversal still counts), then apply the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
